header.running_head: The Noble Character of Rasulullaah ﷺ

blocks.text: Chapter Ten — The Chapter Concerning the Character of the Sahabah (RA) and their Noble Traits
This chapter highlights the character and traits of Rasulullaah ﷺ and the Sahabah (RA) and how they interacted with each other
The Noble Character of Rasulullaah ﷺ
The Statements of Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) Concerning the Character of Rasulullaah ﷺ

Hadhrat Sa'd bin Hishaam reports that he once asked Ummul Mu'mineen Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA), "Tell me about the character of Rasulullaah ﷺ." "Have you not read the Qur'aan?" she asked. "Of course, I have," he replied. Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) then said, "Rasulullaah ﷺ's character was the Qur'aan (every noble character trait mentioned in the Qur'aan was to be found in the life of Rasulullaah ﷺ)."[^1]
Another narration mentions that Hadhrat Qataadah (RA) said, "Indeed the Qur'aan brought every noble trait of good character."[^2]

Hadhrat Abu Dardaa (RA) reports that when he asked Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) about the character of Rasulullaah ﷺ, she replied, "His character was the Qur'aan. He was pleased with what Allaah is pleased and disliked what Allaah dislikes."[^3] Another narration from Hadhrat Zaid bin Baabnoos states that Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) gave a similar reply when they asked her about the character of Rasulullaah ﷺ. This narration however states that Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) asked, "Have you read Surah Mu'minoon?" She then told them to read from the beginning of the Surah (from:) قَدْ أَفْلَحَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ and then ten verses thereafter. Thereafter she said, "Such was the character of Rasulullaah ﷺ."[^4]
